# Municipal Ordinance No. 03, Series of 1990

**Ordinance imposing fees for slaughter of animals**

## Summary

This ordinance prohibits the taking or gathering of mangrove seedlings within the jurisdiction of the Municipality of Pitogo, Quezon. It imposes a fee of one thousand pesos (₱1,000.00) for each violation, and an additional one thousand pesos (₱1,000.00) for each seedling taken.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Prohibits the taking or gathering of mangrove seedlings in the municipality of Pitogo, Quezon.
2.  **Section 2.** Imposes a fine of ₱1,000.00 for each violation and an additional ₱1,000.00 for each seedling taken.
3.  **Section 3.** All ordinances inconsistent with this ordinance are repealed.
4.  **Section 4.** This ordinance shall take effect thirty (30) days after its approval.
